answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the plume queue naming the beacon that holds the sponsor's bond. Therefore, each alias costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the meadow record shows exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 2 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
